# Miro

Miro is a collaborative online whiteboard enabling teams to brainstorm ideas, design wireframes, plan workflows, and manage projects visually

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/miro/.

## Actions

- **Create App Card Item**: Add an app card item to a board.
- **Create Board**: Create a new board.
- **Delete App Card Item**: Delete an app card item from a board.
- **Delete Document Item**: Delete a document item from a board.
- **Delete Item**: Delete a specific item from a board.
- **Get App Card Item**: Retrieve a specific app card item by its id.
- **Get Board**: Retrieve details of a specific board.
- **Get Board Members**: Retrieve a list of members for a board.
- **Get Boards**: Retrieve accessible boards with optional filters.
- **Get Connectors** (read-only): Retrieve a list of connectors on a board.
- **Get Tag**: Retrieve details of a specific tag on a board.
- **List Organizations**: Retrieve list of organizations accessible to the user.
- **Update App Card Item**: Update an app card item on a board.
- **Update Board**: Update properties of a specific board.
